content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Officer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AIIMS Jodhpur Research Officer (Medical/Non-Medical) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate in Health Science (MBBS/Equivalent) and Postgraduate in Public Health/ equivalent from a recognized college/University. OR Graduate in Health Science (MBBS/Equivalent) from a recognized College/University + 3 Years' Experience in Community Project. OR Post Graduate in Science from a recognized college/University with PhD.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Officer (Medical/Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Officer (Medical/Non-Medical) position at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 22 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for which AIIMS Jodhpur is recruiting?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur is recruiting for the post of Research Officer (Medical/Non-Medical) as part of its 2026 recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Officer (Medical/Non-Medical) position announced by AIIMS Jodhpur in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online; they can directly attend the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Officer (Medical/Non-Medical) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 57,652/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Officer post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include a Graduate in Health Science (MBBS/Equivalent) with a Postgraduate in Public Health/equivalent, or a Graduate in Health Science with 3 years of experience in a community project, or a Postgraduate in Science with a PhD.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Officer (Medical/Non-Medical) position will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan, PIN 342005.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
